body:
## Summary

- add `check_file_legality` as an evidence-oriented, per-category and per-jurisdiction pipeline with no global legal verdict
- inspect real files for signatures, streaming SHA-256, and bounded Exif author/copyright/camera/time/GPS provenance
- compose versioned policy packs and independent provider adapters while retaining detector failures and uncertainty
- fail closed on externally confirmed authorized child-safety provider receipts without hashing, extracting metadata, or invoking ordinary detectors
- expose the report through `formal-ai file-legality`, a safe synthetic example, and a documented case study

Closes #835.

## Reproduction and verification

Commit `9470916b` preserves the minimum failing contract: it did not compile because `formal_ai::file_legality` was absent. The implementation makes that contract and the executable CLI checks pass.

Local verification:

- `cargo test --test unit issue_835_file_legality` — 8 passed
- `cargo test --test issue_835_cli` — 2 passed
- `cargo test --lib --bins --tests --all-features --verbose` — 2,367 passed, 3 ignored in the largest target; all other targets passed
- `cargo test --doc --all-features --verbose` — passed
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — passed
- `cargo clippy --lib --bins --tests --all-features -- -D warnings` — passed
- `cargo check --examples --all-features` — passed
- file-size and hardcoded-language policy scripts — passed

## Safety and scope

This does not ship a global law database, prohibited-content corpus, pseudo-PhotoDNA implementation, or legal-clearance boolean. A negative observation is reported only as no risk signal detected; missing evidence remains unknown. Confirmed child-safety matches are accepted only as authorized-provider integration receipts and trigger refusal plus escalation through that provider.

## Formal AI evidence

The five reviewed contribution leaves and the real Formal AI/Agent CLI-authored provider-safety leaf are documented in [`docs/case-studies/issue-835/`](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/tree/issue-835-67812322c263/docs/case-studies/issue-835). Session `ses_03d2a3c95ffe1gfVxnh24MtxFi` produced the pinned artifact byte-for-byte; commit `84780054` carries the paired provenance trailers.
